invariants.rationale: The context is passed as a parameter and is used in object construction, indicating it is expected to be non-null.
The logCompactionInstantTime is passed to another object indicating it should be non-null.
The returned HoodieWriteMetadata should not be null after conversion from an executor result.
The result is constructed (or transformed) and returned as HoodieWriteMetadata.
The underlying List<WriteStatus> in the returned metadata is expected to be non-null, provided by the executor.
